title: How do we add LXXXVII and LXXVIII in Roman?
description: Two Roman numerals are added by counting each symbol and swapping full groups for bigger symbols, one after another, from the smallest upwards. The video does this for the numerals for 87 and 78, and checks the sum with our own numbers. Keeko's doubt is that all the symbols can stay in one row.
teaching_notes: One idea: swapping a full group can make a new full group, so keep regrouping from the smallest symbol upwards. Here five I make a V, two V make an X, five X make an L and two L make a C. Watch for students who stop after one swap.

source: Add LXXXVII and LXXVIII without converting them to Hindu num
video_script.why: The child sees that one swap of a full group can create another full group, so regrouping goes on from the smallest symbol up to the largest.
video_script.substitution: Count each kind of symbol, then swap full groups for the next bigger symbol one kind at a time, starting from the smallest.
video_script.anchor: the two Roman numerals LXXXVII and LXXVIII written one above the other
video_script.wrong_answer: put every symbol in one long row, without swapping any full groups
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko puts all the symbols of both numerals in one long row. The row has the right value, but it still holds full groups, such as five I and two L.
video_script.payoff_line: The sum is see el ex vee

final_answer.spoken: see el ex vee, which is one hundred sixty five

never_show: the answer card before the last beat of the board solution
maths_rules: count the symbols: L's 1 + 1 = 2, X's 3 + 2 = 5, V's 1 + 1 = 2, I's 2 + 3 = 5
5 I's make a V, so there are 3 V's; 2 V's make an X and 1 V stays
now there are 5 + 1 = 6 X's; 5 X's make an L and 1 X stays, so there are 3 L's
2 L's make a C and 1 L stays
the sum is C, L, X and V: CLXV = 100 + 50 + 10 + 5 = 165
video_script.design: One idea: keep swapping full groups, smallest symbol first, because one swap can create the next full group. The numerals stay on the stage and their symbols slide into piles.

<bookmark mark='lines'/>Then we count each pile, and swap full groups for bigger symbols.

beats.on_screen: Step 1: count the symbols: L's 1 + 1 = 2, X's 3 + 2 = 5, V's 1 + 1 = 2, I's 2 + 3 = 5

marks.m1: the L pile is counted and 1 + 1 = 2 is written
marks.m2: the X pile is counted and 3 + 2 = 5 is written
marks.m3: the V pile is counted and 1 + 1 = 2 is written, then the I pile and 2 + 3 = 5

narration: <bookmark mark='s1'/>Step one, count the symbols of each kind.
<bookmark mark='m1'/>One el and one el make two el.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Three ex and two ex make five ex.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>One vee and one vee make two vee. Two eye and three eye make five eye.

beats.on_screen: Step 2: 5 I's make a V, so 3 V's; 2 V's make an X and 1 V stays; X's are now 5 + 1 = 6

marks.m4: the five I symbols are swapped for one V, and the V pile now shows three
marks.m5: two V symbols are swapped for one X and one V stays, and the X pile now shows six

narration: <bookmark mark='s2'/>Step two, start with the smallest symbols.
<bookmark mark='m4'/>Five eye make one vee, and now there are three vee.
<bookmark mark='m5'/>Two vee make one ex, and one vee stays. That adds one more ex, so there are six ex.

beats.on_screen: Step 3: 5 X's make an L and 1 X stays; L's are now 2 + 1 = 3

marks.m6: five of the six X symbols are swapped for one L, one X stays, and the L pile now shows three

narration: <bookmark mark='s3'/>Step three, look at the six ex.
<bookmark mark='m6'/>Five ex make one el, and one ex stays. The el pile then holds three el.

beats.on_screen: Step 4: 2 L's make a C and 1 L stays; nothing more can be swapped

marks.m7: two of the three L symbols are swapped for one C, and one L stays
marks.m8: the piles C, L, X and V are checked, and none holds a full group

narration: <bookmark mark='s4'/>Step four, look at the three el.
<bookmark mark='m7'/>Two el make one see, and one el stays.
<bookmark mark='m8'/>Nothing more can be swapped, so we write the symbols from the biggest.

marks.res: the symbols of the answer add back to 165

narration: <bookmark mark='pay'/>The sum is see el ex vee.
<bookmark mark='chk'/>Check with our numbers. Eighty seven plus seventy eight makes one hundred sixty five.
<bookmark mark='res'/>See el ex vee is one hundred, fifty, ten and five. That adds to one hundred sixty five.
